patch:
Index: Quake/materials/liquids.material
===================================================================
--- Quake/materials/liquids.material	
+++ Quake/materials/liquids.material	
@@ -1,14 +1,15 @@
-#lava1
-{
-    qer_editorimage enter01
-
-    // 1) Base
-    {
-        map textures/#lava1
+#lava1
+{
+    qer_editorimage enter01
+    emissive true
+
+    // 1) Base
+    {
+        map textures/#lava1
         tcmod scale .2 .2
 	tcmod scroll .04 .03
         tcMod turb 0 .1 0 .01
         blendFunc GL_ONE GL_ZERO
 	rgbGen wave sin 0.90 0.10 0 1.2
     }		
-}
\ No newline at end of file
+}
